defectRejections.message: Artifact buffer is missing or empty. Cannot capture zero-byte output.
Rejecting 8-byte corrupt/placeholder file (8 bytes). Invariant: Eight-byte outputs cannot become ready (CV-13).
Wrong format output: Buffer does not start with valid PNG magic bytes (0x89PNG).
PDF Print preflight defect: File color space is not CMYK (FR-038).
Temporary Canva download URL has expired. Ephemeral links cannot be treated as durable backups (CV-13).

uncertainJobReconciliation.guarantee: Uncertain export jobs are reconciled by polling rather than repeating duplicate export requests.

acceptance: Missing, eight-byte, wrong-format, corrupt, and expired-link outputs are strictly blocked.
